overview: Premium luxury chess academy website for Aim Chess Academy in Barasat, Kolkata — built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS for Vercel deployment. Features a stunning dark-mode-first design with gold accents, glassmorphism cards, animated chess pieces, and all the sections needed to attract new students.
features: Dark/light mode toggle with localStorage persistence
Animated hero with floating chess pieces
WhatsApp and Call floating action buttons
